;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency|ADF insurgency in the Democratic Republic of the Congo]]
**Twelve [[civilian]]s are killed in an attack by militants. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/drc-army-killed-top-adf-leader-civilian-toll-rises-191130081713060.html (Al Jazeera)]
**Two alleged rebels are [[lynched]] by civilians who suspected that the two were involved in the deaths of dozens of civilians since November 5. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/africa/crowd-in-dr-congo-lynches-two-suspected-militants-as-un-envoy-visits (''The Straits Times'')]
**The [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|DR Congo armed forces]] say that they have killed a top militant, Mouhamed Mkubwa Islam, who is one of three leaders of the [[insurgency]]. [https://africa.cgtn.com/2019/11/30/dr-congo-army-says-it-has-killed-top-rebel-leader/ (CGNT)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Nine people are killed and another three are injured in a plane crash in [[Sioux Falls, South Dakota]], [[United States]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2019/11/30/plane-crash-south-dakota-kills-nine-people-ntsb-says/4343688002/ (''USA Today'')]

;International relations
*[[Japan–North Korea relations]]
**In an insult-laden statement, [[Media of North Korea|North Korean media]] warn [[Prime Minister of Japan|Japanese Prime Minister]] [[Shinzō Abe]] that he "may see a real [[ballistic missile]] in the near future." [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-japan/north-korea-warns-japans-abe-may-soon-see-real-ballistic-missile-launch-idUSKBN1Y32GB (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[2019 Samoa measles outbreak|Samoa measles epidemic]]
**The [[Prime Minister of Samoa]], [[Tuilaʻepa Saʻilele Malielegaoi|Tuilaepa Sailele Malielegaoi]], says that he will propose a law which would penalize parents who [[anti-vaccination|refuse to vaccinate]] their children, amid an ongoing [[epidemic]] that has killed 44 people, mostly children under the age of four. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/404533/samoa-govt-allocates-more-funds-for-measles-epidemic (RNZ)]

Police use [[tear gas]] to disperse the protestors. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tunisia-protests/tunisians-protest-in-southern-town-after-man-sets-himself-alight-idUSKBN1Y40O7?il=0 (Reuters)]
